purpose: turn parsed Agent Document chunks into retrieval-ready evidence with measurable recall before memory, knowledge, or specialist handoff

layer_policy.name: flat chunking and retrieval
layer_policy.local_baseline: recursive chunking plus BM25-lite lexical retrieval, deterministic rerank, confidence calibration, and refusal threshold
layer_policy.use_when: standard RAG, Agent memory search, evidence narrowing, and source-targeted retrieval

layer_policy.name: structured expansion
layer_policy.gate: external or LLM-backed summarization/entity extraction remains a gated candidate
layer_policy.use_when: cross-chunk reasoning is frequent enough to justify additional cost and validation

layer_policy.name: ontology-constrained retrieval
layer_policy.gate: ontology/schema creation or external ontology use requires owner route and current authority
layer_policy.use_when: law, compliance, medicine, industrial standards, or another domain with strict schema boundaries

selection_rules.condition: domain ontology exists or strict schema boundary is required

selection_rules.route: L2 RAPTOR candidate after L1 baseline measurement

selection_rules.condition: answers require horizontal entity relationship traversal
selection_rules.route: L2 GraphRAG candidate after L1 baseline measurement

selection_rules.condition: general text, FAQ, logs, project notes, or Agent memory
high recall is required and latency/cost budget allows

rerank_calibration_contract.local_rerank: deterministic lexical cross-feature rerank over BM25 score, term coverage, exact phrase match, and chunk id tie-breaks

calibration.method: temperature-scaled logistic confidence over normalized local rerank features

rerank_calibration_contract.refusal_rule: if top calibrated confidence is below threshold, return a refusal decision instead of treating retrieval as answerable
rerank_calibration_contract.external_reranker_rule: cross-encoder, Cohere, BGE, FlashRank, or other model-backed rerankers remain gated candidates and must report calibration metrics before durable use

evaluation_contract.rule: record retrieval and calibration metrics when a chunking, rerank, or threshold strategy affects durable memory, knowledge, or architecture claims

allowed_without_extra_gate: local evaluation over non-secret task data
authority_boundary.privacy_rule: retrieval indexes over private task data remain ignored local state unless explicitly promoted through verified knowledge rules
authority_boundary.source_verification_rule: retrieved chunks route attention; current source files, parsed document validation, and tests remain final proof
